content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "Newcomers can apply for benefit payments before they file their first tax return, using form RC151 or form RC66 [s10-c500-000]. A new resident without children applies with form RC151, or online through the CRA web form [s10-c500-000]. New residents without children fill out form RC151 and send it, or use the online web form, before they file their first return [s16-c500-000]. New residents with children under 19 apply for the Canada child benefit with form RC66, which also applies them for the groceries benefit [s16-c500-000]."}
